## TEAM KNOWLEDGE COORDINATION
HOW DO WE WORK?  Team exercise:  Discuss your team’s work practices, communication protocols, as well as roles & responsibilities.
- Team Meetings. What is the purpose of these?  What is their frequency, time, location, and duration? Are they FtF or Virtual?  What are the meeting roles (Weekly Agendas & Minutes, Time Keeper, Scribe, etc.)?  Are there meeting protocols we want to agree to?
- Communication Tools: What types of technology will we employ and for what purposes? Ex. Email, Google Docs, Google Hangout, Dropbox, Slack, etc.
- Work Rhythms, Response Times & Working Styles: What information requests do we have of each other?  How do members prefer to communicate? What systems or signals will trigger us to update each other on developments?  What constraints and work rhythm preferences do members have?  How would we describe our individual working styles and how might that impact the way we approach work as a team?
